definitions.explanation: To get rid of something by putting it in the trash or otherwise disposing of it. To abandon or give up something.

examples.japanese: ゴミを{捨|す}ててください。
{古|ふる}い{服|ふく}を{捨|す}てました。
まだ{使|つか}えるから{捨|す}てないで。
examples.english: Don't throw it away because it's still usable.

notes: This is an ichidan verb. Te-form is {捨|す}てて. Can also mean to abandon (a person, pet, or idea) in a more figurative sense. Opposite of {拾|ひろ}う (to pick up).
